verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card and rewards product, and card platforms can plausibly offer event webhooks (e.g. for transactions), so the axis applies. The evidence covers only rewards, partner perks and onboarding, with no mention of registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is also no API surface where webhooks could be documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
